Name: Tahla's Crops
Author: SquishyMiqoteMods
Description:
[size=4]VERSION 0.0.4 HAS BEEN RELEASED. If you come from 0.0.2, completely delete the prior [CP] Tahla's Crops and Cassie's Garden, and replace it with the new "Tahla's Crops," which contains both [CP], [MFM] and [MYC] content packs that are part of this mod.[/size][size=3]


A small mod with a handful of new crops, including flowers, vegetables and some recipes. Crops included are:

SPRING
Bluebonnet (Flower)
Cherry Tomato
Moss Rose (Flower)
Snow Peas

SUMMER
Cucumber
Moss Rose (Flower)
Red Coleus (Multiharvest flower, not great for honey)

FALL
Snow Peas
Spaghetti Squash

WINTER
Spaghetti Squash
Kumquat Tree

FOODS
Cherry Tomato Sauce
Cucumber and Cherry Tomato Salad
Spaghetti Squash Pasta
Sautéed Snow Peas
Kumquat Tart


More to come at a future date, from plants to foods. Possibly more fruit trees.


Bugs and issues may be reported here or on our github:
[url=https://github.com/Miqote-Petter/Tahlas-Crops/issues]https://github.com/Miqote-Petter/Tahlas-Crops/issues
[/url][/size][size=3]
Special thanks to the Stardew discord community in their #making-mods-general channel. Shoutouts to 6480 for teaching me how to make CP json's and showing me many examples needed to do what I wanted done here as well as helping with troubleshooting, and EnderTedi for pushing me to learn things and pointing me in the directions needed when troubleshooting, and everybody else that has helped (there's many of you).

Listed below are localisations or translated that have been provided. If you wish to localise this mod, you have all requisite permissions to do so; I will link them below, with credit to you, if you inform me of their existence.
